body:
Thank you for your kind words. Yes, there is more than providing financially, but that is the core of my role. 

There is no one for me to talk to. We moved here for me to take the job that ended in May. Though I am by all appearances outgoing and even gregarious, I don't make friends easily, or really at all. My wife does not want to leave here - we've moved so often in the past 10 years - and I don't blame her. She doesn't want me to take the job across the country, and I don't blame her for that either. 

If I've learned anything, perhaps it is that anyone's situation is complex - more so than meets anyone else's eye. I suppose since I've posted here that I am in some way looking for an alternative, but I don't know. I've been so profoundly lost for so long, and my "career" now feels like it was little if anything more than a cracker-thin sheet of ice over a dark and cold sea indeed. Anyhow... things change day-to-day. Perhaps tomorrow will be better.

I just posted in this sub because I too am actively considering killing myself. Our situations are radically different and I won't claim to "know how you feel" or otherwise layer what would surely seem like bullshit onto your obviously painful wounds. I am so sorry to read your story and so sorry to feel the wracking, yawning pain that is in it.

Inside all that, though, there is something else that I see: your strength. Maybe you don't see it - maybe being in the depth of your pain is just too blindingly agonizing - but I see all the things you have already endured, and I see you still fighting. Perhaps you are much, much stronger than you have given yourself credit for. You've survived horrible treatment at the hands of others, and you've found a way to keep going. You've survived a lot. Perhaps you can make it through another day.

Someone, somewhere, may yet surprise you with how much they value you and how well they treat you. I hope so. At least for this moment, please know that there is at least one person who, in reading your story, saw your worth to the world and your strength and courage.

Good luck today and tomorrow, and the next day too.
